status: candidate (step 2: development); NOT frozen; research references not computed
question: How much of the gap to the Bayes bound can a better readout close while the Mandala stays unchanged?
mandala: unchanged: M10 frozen functions m10_task.network/readout_states (tag m10-freeze), tanh, sigma 0.02, W 3, p 0.5

streams.train: (seed, kind in {pattern, noise}, role 'train'), independent of n and case; n are prefixes
streams.test: (seed, kind, role 'test'): one independent test stream per seed, shared within the seed across n, cases and decoders

decoders.nearest_mean: no standardisation, as M3-M10; evaluated exactly (plan 2.1) and on the test set
decoders.lda_ledoit_wolf: as M10 (m10_decoders.LedoitWolfLDA); evaluated exactly and on the test set

mlp.training: Adam (0.9, 0.999, 1e-8), full batch, BCE with logits + L2 on weights, early stopping on validation log-loss
mlp.selection_rule_hyperparameters: grid lr in {0.003, 0.01, 0.03} x l2 in {1e-5, 1e-4, 1e-3}, patience 100, max_epochs 3000, 1 init; smallest mean VALIDATION log-loss over the development cases and n in {1000, 16000}, dev seeds; no test data
mlp.validation: every 5th pair of the n-prefix (20 %, class-stratified, pairs together), taken from the same budget n
mlp.standardisation: mean/std of the fit part only
mlp.init_selection: smallest validation log-loss; ties -> smallest init index

hyperparameter_selection_result.rule: grid lr in {0.003, 0.01, 0.03} x l2 in {1e-5, 1e-4, 1e-3}, patience 100, max_epochs 3000, 1 init; smallest mean VALIDATION log-loss over the development cases and n in {1000, 16000}, dev seeds; no test data
hyperparameter_selection_result.note: the chosen point lies at the EDGE of the pre-stated grid (largest lr and l2); kept because the rule was fixed in advance; no further search
hyperparameter_selection_result.data: development cases and seeds 901-903 only; validation log-loss only; no test data

mlp.divergence_rule: any non-finite input, standardisation value, training loss, gradient, parameter or validation loss -> MLPDivergence -> the run ends with status failed (no retry, no skipping, no fallback); regular early stopping restores the best VALID epoch
mlp.recorded_metadata: hyperparameters; per init index, stream key, best validation loss, epochs; selected init; integer fit/validation sizes; split rule; checked in the runner AND in the gate

linear_reference.method: L-BFGS-B on -acc(w, b), w = u/||u||, b free, numerical gradient; starts NM(inf), LDA(inf), 20 random; non-losable candidates NM(inf), LDA(inf)
linear_reference.label: numerical linear reference L_found (lower bound of the linear optimum L*); B - L_found is an UPPER bound of the nonlinearity gap

C-Daten.question: Do more examples help LDA?
C-Daten.contrast: acc_LDA(16000) - acc_LDA(1000), exact population accuracy of the trained rules, paired by seed

C-Modell.question: Is the MLP learning procedure better than LDA at n = 1000?
C-Modell.contrast: BA_MLP(1000) - BA_LDA(1000), both on the same per-seed test set, paired by seed
C-Modell.meaning: compares concrete learning procedures (incl. optimisation/validation), not the model class in isolation; does not show that nonlinearity is necessary

confirmatory.test: one-sided t test of (mean paired seed difference - delta), df = 19; normality of the seed differences is an ASSUMPTION; whole-seed bootstrap intervals reported alongside
confirmatory.zero_variance_rule: if the seed differences have zero variance: p = 0 if mean > delta else 1
report: unadjusted 95% t interval and bootstrap interval

wording.contrary: Richtung widerspricht, only if the unadjusted 95% interval lies entirely below 0

descriptive: convergence diagnostic |mean_seed acc_D(16000) - acc_D(inf)| <= 0.01 for NM and LDA (no one-sided requirement)
decomposition B - acc_D(n) = [B - L_found] + [L_found - acc_D(inf)] + [acc_D(inf) - acc_D(n)] with the readings of plan 2.4 (last term signed)
MLP learning curve over n; secondary case and K0 controls (K0: decoders within delta of B at large n expected; deviation = diagnostic finding)
test-set cross-check of the exact linear accuracies

closed share = ratio of seed means with a PAIRED whole-seed bootstrap (the same resampled seeds for D and LDA1000); replicates with denominator <= 0.01 are invalid and counted; point denominator <= 0.01 -> N/A; B fixed, its MC SE reported separately
intervals of absolute gaps and of the signed sampling term are conditional on the fixed references (named so)

uncertainty.training_draw: seed level (paired seed differences, whole-seed bootstrap 2000 reps, seed 2026100412)
uncertainty.mlp_test: inside each seed value (100 000 test pairs), captured by the seed spread; test streams independent across seeds
uncertainty.bayes_se: taken from M10, common to all seeds, NOT in the seed bootstrap; reported separately for absolute gaps and shares; cancels in C-Daten and C-Modell

time_limit.kind: elapsed wall-clock (time.monotonic), checked cooperatively before every unit, in every MLP epoch and before completion
time_limit.max_overshoot: about one MLP epoch or one evaluation step (no guaranteed bound)
time_limit.decision_pending: runtime check estimated about 68 min for 20 seeds; options A (raise to 5400 s, keep all points), B, C; to be decided by Johann before the reference phase

phases: 2 code/tests + hyperparameters on development cases + runtime check -> implementation review
3 version procedures/decisions, then compute research references ONCE (model-based reference phase); no selection afterwards
4 freeze (protocol + references + code hashes + reviewed commit), smoke, one research run, evaluation through the gate

development.note: K0 controls are identical in development and research (no distractor) and are used for the hyperparameter choice; they carry no hypothesis

binding.m10: before ANY state computation (dev, reference phase, smoke, research) m10_run.require_frozen() must pass (M10 protocol + code hashes); the M10 binding is recorded in references, results and the freeze record
binding.references: the evaluated references must equal the frozen artifact protocol/m11_references.json (content), whose SHA-256 is in the freeze record; values finite and plausible; otherwise not released
binding.reference_phase: only via m11_references.research_reference_phase(): refuses if artifact, claim or failure record exists, if M11 procedures/protocol are not committed or M10 is not frozen -- all BEFORE computing; exclusive claim file; a failure writes protocol/m11_references.failed.json (no silent retry)
